channel.title: The Crisp Kitchen — new guides
channel.description: Air fryers and the tools that make them work — tested against what the listing actually says.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: The single biggest fork in the category, and the one the shelf labels hide. Four questions that separate the two shapes before you look at watts.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts, litres, baskets, and the difference between "6 quart" meaning one drawer or two. A checklist you can run against any listing in two minutes.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs that arrive after the purchase. What to measure on your own counter, and what each shape demands of a sink.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Every extra function is a promise about a mode you will use twice. Five questions that separate a useful multi-function appliance from a crowded control panel.
